label: C2 difference: a CONTINGENCY_1 being with a distinct esse CAUSE_2 is receptive or has a PRIOR_1 one
paraphrase: Difference statement of C2 over C2-minus (#1598), OPEN, not asserted: every candidate contingent at w that has some other being causing its esse (CAUSE_2 at esse, tenseless) is existentially receptive or has some other being that causes its esse and is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to it. B3 implies it; it is weaker than B3.
